mentions.name: Bid-Euchre.com
mentions.description: This is a site for playing Bid Euchre, a variant of Euchre in which players bid to determine the trump suit. It has reached 5,000 completed games.
mentions.audience: Euchre players, particularly people in the author's hometown who play the game
mentions.source_excerpt: Bid-Euchre.com (https://bid-euchre.com/) - If you have ever played Euchre this is a bid based way to determine suit. A lot of people in my home town play it. Just hit 5k completed games.
